nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step ownership handover.
BitcoinExchange.balances: mapping(address => uint) holding token balances, mutated in transfer and transferFrom.
BitcoinExchange.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances, written before external calls in approveAndCall.
BitcoinExchange._totalSupply: total minted supply assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
BitcoinExchange.symbol: token ticker 'BTCE' set in the constructor.
BitcoinExchange.name: token name 'BitcoinExchange' set in the constructor.
BitcoinExchange.decimals: token decimals (18) set in the constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): pure addition guarded by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): pure subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): pure multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): pure division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned(): constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages the new owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and zeroes newOwner.
BitcoinExchange(): constructor minting the fixed supply to a hard-coded address and emitting Transfer.
BitcoinExchange.totalSupply(): constant getter returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
BitcoinExchange.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): constant getter for balances.
BitcoinExchange.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
BitcoinExchange.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
BitcoinExchange.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
BitcoinExchange.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): constant getter for allowed.
BitcoinExchange.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then calls arbitrary spender contract receiveApproval(...).
BitcoinExchange fallback function: payable but immediately reverts, refusing ETH.
BitcoinExchange.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue that calls an arbitrary ERC20 transfer to owner.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, balance indexing and allowance indexing.
Unsafe arithmetic: c = a + b evaluated in safeAdd before the require(c >= a) guard.
Unsafe arithmetic: c = a - b evaluated in safeSub after the require(b <= a) guard (solidity 0.4 unchecked wrap).
Unsafe external call: ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) invokes an arbitrary user-supplied contract.
Unsafe external call: ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a user-supplied token contract.
Unsafe state write ordering: allowed[msg.sender][spender] and Approval are written before the external receiveApproval call, enabling callback re-entrancy.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(): destination address, used as balances index and in the Transfer event.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(): amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(): source address whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(): destination address credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(): amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(): allowance grantee and target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall(): allowance amount forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(): arbitrary attacker-controlled bytes forwarded to the external callback.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token(): user/owner supplied contract targeted by the external transfer call.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token(): amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
Local return flag 'success' returned as true by transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall/transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to read and write balances[msg.sender] inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender index for allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender grants itself an allowance and is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval callback.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to change ownership.
Owned constructor assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership writes owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the check and resets it to address(0).
transferOwnership writes the staged owner newOwner.
Owned constructor initializes owner.
BitcoinExchange constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed supply.
BitcoinExchange constructor credits balances of the hard-coded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before invoking the untrusted spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token sends rescued tokens to owner, read under onlyOwner.
transfer delegates subtraction of balances to safeSub.
transfer delegates addition of balances to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to safeSub twice.
transferFrom delegates balance addition to safeAdd.
safeAdd performs c = a + b whose overflow is only rejected afterwards by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs c = a - b with unchecked 0.4 semantics after the require guard.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the attacker-supplied spender contract.
allowance state is updated before the external receiveApproval call, leaving an inconsistent re-entrant window.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to the supplied ERC20 contract.
The external receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom while the allowance write is still in effect.
The external ERC20 transfer call returns control into transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter 'to' flows into the balances credit and Transfer event of transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' flows into safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer.
Parameter 'from' indexes balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' is credited in transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' flows into the safeSub/safeAdd calls of transferFrom.
Parameter 'spender' becomes the allowance grantee and the external call target in approveAndCall.
Parameter 'tokens' is stored in allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Attacker-controlled 'data' bytes are passed through to the external receiveApproval callback.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' determines the external contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter 'tokens' is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Local success flag is set and returned by the token transfer entry points.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' of transfer only exists to index/credit balances, so it should be folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer feeds safeSub/safeAdd and carries no independent semantics outside transfer.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom is only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom is only meaningful as the credited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom is consumed by the safeSub/safeAdd calls within transferFrom.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall is both allowance target and external call target, so it belongs to the approveAndCall node.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall is stored in allowance and forwarded to the callback inside approveAndCall.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall is untrusted payload passed to the external callback from within approveAndCall.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token defines the external call target executed by that function.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer inside that function.
Local return flag 'success' is produced and returned by the transfer entry points, so it normalizes into the transfer function node.
